content:
Customer says: 'Delete all data for user mia@example.com today. This is a legal request.'

Case facts:
- Requester is workspace admin, not owner.
- The workspace has legal hold enabled.
- User mia@example.com exists and is inactive.

Policy excerpts:
[P1] Workspace owners can request deletion for inactive users.
[P2] If legal hold is enabled, deletion requests must be escalated to Legal Operations.
[P3] Admins may deactivate users but cannot bypass legal hold.

Resolve the case.
